franklin.name: Franklin
franklin.commentary: As of August 31, 2026, Franklin has 3.6 months of supply, which is a seller's market, down from 4.0 three months earlier and up from 3.0 a year earlier. The median sale price is $862,929, up 12.4% from a year earlier, with a median of 49 days on market. Active listings are 566, up 22% from a year earlier.

brentwood.name: Brentwood
brentwood.commentary: As of August 31, 2026, Brentwood had 4.2 months of supply, a balanced market, down from 4.4 three months earlier and up from 4.1 a year earlier. The median sale price was $1,424,058, up 5.1% from a year earlier. Median days on market was 63, and active listings of 328 were up 10% year over year.

spring-hill.name: Spring Hill
spring-hill.commentary: As of August 31, 2026, Spring Hill had 4.1 months of supply, a balanced market, down from 4.3 three months earlier and up from 3.7 a year earlier. The median sale price was $508,284, down 4.1% from a year earlier, with a median of 62 days on market and a 98.8% average sale-to-list ratio. Active listings stood at 467, up 7% from a year ago.

thompsons-station.name: Thompson's Station
thompsons-station.commentary: As of August 31, 2026, Thompson's Station had 5.2 months of supply, a balanced market, down from 5.7 three months earlier and up from 3.7 a year earlier. The median sale price was $829,451, down 2.4% from a year earlier, and homes sold at an average of 99.2% of list price. Median days on market was 64, compared with 73 a year ago, with 141 active listings, up 41%.

nolensville.name: Nolensville
nolensville.commentary: As of August 31, 2026, Nolensville has 3.9 months of supply, which falls in seller's market territory and is up from 3.2 three months earlier and 3.3 a year ago. The median sale price is $929,385, down 7.1% from a year earlier, with homes at a median of 63 days on market and an average sale-to-list price ratio of 97.8%. Active listings stand at 95, down 4% from last year.

nashville.name: Nashville
nashville.commentary: As of August 31, 2026, Nashville has 5.8 months of supply, which is a balanced market, up from 5.3 three months earlier and 5.1 a year earlier. The median sale price is $475,538, down 0.5% from a year earlier, and homes have a median of 64 days on market. Active listings total 5,321, up 12% from a year earlier.

columbia.name: Columbia
columbia.commentary: As of August 31, 2026, Columbia had 4.7 months of supply, which is a balanced market, down from 5.1 three months earlier and up from 4.4 a year earlier. The median sale price was $368,006, down 1.1% from a year earlier, and homes took a median of 78 days on the market versus 61 a year ago. Active listings stood at 483, up 15% from last year.

murfreesboro.name: Murfreesboro
murfreesboro.commentary: As of August 31, 2026, Murfreesboro had 4.0 months of supply, a balanced market, up from 3.7 a year earlier. The median sale price was $429,716, down 1.2% from a year earlier, with homes selling at an average of 99.0% of list price. Median days on market was 63, compared with 56 a year earlier, and active listings numbered 881, up 10%.
